items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: Then Dan Taggart played saxophone... So, Dan got his saxophone... I said, Dan, you got your supraina hole? Yeah. I said, let me have it... ctx.x: Well back to Happy Shilling. Lefty and, what did Frisco play? Drones. Drones.
And they did piano? No piano?
